latest_final: The story is a wordplay puzzle: "courses" are not academic classes but the dishes/courses of a catered meal. I was a HKU student who had to choose my meal/course selections before a deadline, and I submitted my choices. However, the meal took place that evening and the dishes I had selected were all served and eaten (by others at the event and/or in the course of the meal) before I could have them—so all "my courses" were gone in one evening. My own submission/choice set the meal in motion, which is why the opening says I caused it, and why the dishes vanished that same evening at the catered event.
